description: Java interface defining a visitor pattern for ExistsFieldExpression objects, specifying methods for visiting attribute, feature, feature ID property, and simple expressions within a query expression framework.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Method to visit an attribute expression with a string key.

methods.name: visitFeature

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
